Delete your Tennisimo account

Last updated November 22, 2026 · Contact: va.appstudio@gmail.com

Delete from the app

  • Open Tennisimo and sign in.
  • Go to Profile (bottom bar), then Delete account.
  • Type DELETE and confirm.

What is deleted

Immediately and permanently: every video you uploaded, every swing analysis, score, match and rally, and your login. Nothing is kept afterwards, and it cannot be undone.

Can't sign in?

Email va.appstudio@gmail.com from the address on your account and ask for deletion. We will delete it and confirm by email.
